text.name: Michal Sobala
text.title: Logistics & Operations Specialist
text.profile: For years, I have been working in the international 3PL logistics and e-commerce environment, gaining experience in pioneering warehouse units of companies such as Albert Heijn and Amazon. I have completed a full career path – from operational work in order picking, through team management, to office work and process supervision. I have actively participated in opening new warehouses and implementing innovative technologies optimizing goods flow.
text.clause: I agree to the processing of personal data provided in this document for the purposes of the recruitment process pursuant to the Personal Data Protection Act of 10 May 2018 (Journal of Laws 2018, item 1000) and in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 (GDPR).

key_competencies: Implementation and testing of new warehouse technologies
Management of goods flow in the warehouse
Allocation of resources and employees in the warehouse
Representation of warehouse units to the central office
Advanced MS Excel skills (including basic VBA)
Preparation of reports and KPI analyses
Knowledge of health and safety regulations

certificates.name: Safety Certificate for Operational Managers VCA VOL
Working Safely with a Reach Truck Certificate

Working Safely with an Electric Pallet Truck Certificate

strengths: Focus on achieving synergy in the team
Positive attitude towards work and people

experience.title: Location Caretaker / Location Manager - Cozy Lodging B.V.
experience.location: Putte, Tilburg, The Netherlands & Turnhout, Belgium
points: Managed daily operations across multiple accommodation sites for agency workers employed by Timing, Tempo-Team, RT&T, Sarens.
Oversaw all arrivals, departures and internal relocations, ensuring smooth onboarding and clear communication of location rules.
Maintained continuous contact with agency coordinators to align planning and occupancy.
Performed administrative tasks including system registration, resident records management and occupancy reporting.
Conducted regular inspections of housing units to monitor technical condition, cleanliness and compliance with facility standards.
Coordinated daily tasks of cleaning staff to ensure efficient turnaround of accommodations after departures and before new arrivals.
Worked closely with the technical department to report issues, schedule repairs and ensure fast, effective resolution of maintenance requests.
Served as the primary contact point for residents, handling damage reports, logging incidents in the system and coordinating follow‑up actions.

subroles.title: Turnhout (capacity 68)
points: Managed a second location with similar responsibilities, ensuring smooth cooperation with OTTO Work Force and maintaining high service standards.

subroles.title: Tilburg (capacity 86)
points: Oversaw the launch of a newly contracted location, setting up operational processes from day one.
Trained a newly hired employee who later became the dedicated caretaker for this site.

experience.title: Facility employee / Location Coordinator - Timing Uitzendbureau
points: Managed day‑to‑day operations across multiple accommodation locations, ensuring safe, clean and compliant living conditions for employees.
Welcomed new arrivals, explained housing rules, assigned accommodation and supported smooth onboarding.

Coordinated transportation logistics, including scheduling company cars/buses, monitoring mileage and arranging service appointments.

Maintained continuous communication with recruitment teams and client offices to organize daily transport to workplaces.

Independently managed a temporary 34‑person location in Terneuzen, handling all arrivals, relocations, transport coordination and final handover.
Successfully completed the Terneuzen seasonal project with zero additional costs for the agency and received positive feedback for excellent cooperation with Goodmorning.
